label: Encoded EXISTENCE_7: an object encodes the property E!
definition: EncodesExistence F x: x encodes the frame's existence property E!, as the abstract object characterized by 'existing, god, omnibenevolent' does. Encoding E! is characterization by existence, not exemplification of it.
note: Analyst reconstruction in the style of Zalta, attribution deferred. Lean defines it as the frame's Encodes applied to concrete. It is the encoding counterpart of part 1's nuclear EXISTENCE_5; no bridge from it to EXISTENCE_6 is asserted, and the encoding control shows that comprehension supplies none.
